第十七章 死灵野兽
前行约二十公里，黄色的沙粒渐渐变成了黑褐色的土壤，远处一团团黑影如同猛兽一样趴在黑暗的荒原上，好像要择人而噬。
以郭飞的视力，几公里远的地方，在黑暗笼罩下，也分辨不出前面是什么，只是看出一个轮廓而已。
郭飞犹豫一下，小心的指挥着尸兵前面带路，慢慢的接近了这片广阔无边的黑影。
“枯树！”近处一看，郭飞顿时诧异半响，这是一排排的枯树，树叶早就落下腐败了，但巨大的树干却错综复杂的、乱七八糟的矗立在这里，有的倒伏、有的依然矗立着，有的已经腐朽，变成了碎屑。有些珍贵坚固的树木依然坚强的抗拒着岁月的侵蚀，顽强的直立着，似乎在期盼阳光重新照耀这片冰冷的土地。
毫无疑问，这曾经是一片广阔的密林，残木断枝诉说着曾经的茂密。
“曾经阳光灿烂，森林密布，到底发生了什么，阳光不再宠幸，变成了死寂的地域？”郭飞顺着残破的巨木，悄然前行，心中疑窦丛生。
“啊！”一声惨叫远远的从前面传来，如同厉鬼在呼叫。
郭飞更加的小心前行，四处查看，在一处枯树林中，似乎有打斗的痕迹，郭飞低头握起一把土闻了闻，一股血腥味传扑面而来。
在地上仔细查看下，不错，正是血迹，而且很多。
在郭飞低头查看的同时，在旁边一个如同房子粗的枯树上，高约三米的一个树洞内露出了两只暗红的眼睛，两只眼睛观察片刻，陡然间，这两只眼睛临空飘出，朝郭飞疾驰而来。近前发现，竟然是一条水桶粗的大蟒蛇，张开大口从上面朝郭飞咬来。
“哧！”在一旁警戒的尸兵身体陡然旋起，手中长剑舞动，朝大蟒蛇刺去，无形剑气划出，和大蟒蛇的脖颈相接触，发出了剧烈的破碎声。
此时，郭飞迅速反应过来，翻身跳出三米远。只见，大蟒蛇受了尸兵一剑，颈部裂开了一个大口，露出了蜡黄的皮肉。
“是死灵！”郭飞心头震动，这个大蟒不是活物，而是死灵。
大蟒狠狠的盯着郭飞，口中喷出团团灰色的雾团，眼中暗红色的光芒越来越亮，显然对郭飞的皮肉产生了无比强烈的欲望。
郭飞不敢怠慢，这个蟒蛇体型庞大，攻击力惊人，尤其可怕的是，他躯体不怕伤害。以郭飞和鬼族士兵作战的经验，必须挖掉其眼内的晶块，消灭其灵魂寄生之地，它才会停止攻击。
忍者弯刀退出，剑影入体，化为剑兵，郭飞将玄铁剑取了出来。如果是自己一人，今天恐怕只有逃命了，但获得一个尸兵后，对付这个大蟒，郭飞有信心，大蟒似乎智力不高，只盯着郭飞袭击，尸兵不主动攻击它，它就置若罔闻。
“死！”郭飞暗喝一声，身体陡然飘起，脚蹬着枯木，身体窜起一丈高，朝大蟒劈去。
大蟒身体一扭，从地上抬起巨大的头颅，朝郭飞吞噬而去。
与此同时，郭飞心神一动，指挥尸兵身体陡然纵起，将剑狠狠的插在了大蟒的半身处，将其钉在了地上，瞬间阻止了它的跃起。

郭飞就等的这个时刻，玄铁剑狠狠的劈在了瞬间失去移动能力的大蟒脖颈处，水桶粗的头颅应声而落，大蟒身体陡然倒地，散出了一团浓郁的灰气，郭飞赶紧闪开，这灰色气流让他无比的厌恶，似乎可以消融身体内的活力。
尸兵则不然，见到浓郁的灰气团团的从大蟒身体上溢出，他欢呼一声，移动到灰气旁，张开大嘴，猛然的将灰气往口中吸入，如同鲸鱼吸水一样将浓郁的气团吸入了体内。
大蟒身体上的灰气散尽后，其干瘪的皮肉瞬间变成了飞灰，只留下了一副骨骼。在其头部，两块拳头大小的晶块闪烁着蓝莹莹的光芒。
“这么大块的魂晶！”郭飞惊诧的同时，赶紧拿在手中，将其收进了兵符空间中。
“咦！”郭飞看了一眼尸兵，发现他的脸庞比先前圆润了很多，干瘪的皮肤竟然鼓了起来。
难道他吸收了死气后，可以纳为己用？
郭飞顾不得多想，化身为忍者，身体飘起，小心的跃上了树干，朝树洞中探查，以忍者的敏锐，郭飞没有发现树洞内还有异物，但还是小心的让尸兵先进去，然后才小心的探入。
洞内空间很大，如同一间房子大小，放置不少杂乱的物体，更是有大量的骨骼和衣物。郭飞查看一下，这个大蟒吞噬了数名人族兵士，其血肉可能被大蟒吞噬消化了，剩余的衣物和骨骼被排泄了出来，地上还有两把剑、三张弓和三筒箭。
郭飞指挥尸兵将其整理一下，贵重的东西捡起来，这都是财富呀，郭飞穷的叮当响，自然要取走有价值的东西。
在衣物中，找到了十二块指甲盖大小的骷髅魂晶，两袋炒面，两个没有破碎的水袋，里面灌满了水。
人是铁饭是钢，食物对于郭飞来说太重要了，进入落日沙漠，他只带了几天的食物，没水没食物，撑不了多久。
郭飞将兵器、魂晶和食物一起收进了兵符空间中。并取出自己随身携带的食物和水，吃了起来。
尸兵刚才吸收了灰色的死气，这个时候精神了很多。郭飞发现，尸兵也不是精力无限的，他在作战中也要消耗能量，一旦能量不济，就没有了战力。他的能量正是这些灰色的气体，以现在的修为，郭飞已经可以感知到了，这是一股死气。
这里异常的隐蔽，尸兵也不需要吃饭，郭飞让尸兵守卫在树洞口，自己靠在树洞壁上休整下。
开战以来已经过了两天了，一直没有休息，早就困乏了，闭上眼就睡着了。睡梦中，郭飞似乎又回到了大学宿舍中，同学放假归来，各自拿出家乡的土特产分吃，诉说着放假期间的艳遇、约会。打打闹闹、吆五喝六中吃的满嘴流油。
“沙沙沙！”一声轻微的响声从树洞外传来。郭飞咂摸一下嘴，回味着家乡的“小咸鱼”，觉得口中淡出“鸟”来了。似乎好久没有吃过一顿大餐了，听到响声清醒过来，心中暗恼，不知什么东西打断了他的美梦。
尸兵警惕的趴在树洞口，虎视眈眈的盯着外面。郭飞凑过去一看，顿时倒吸了一口冷气。
狼群，约五六十个，团团的围住了这棵大树。不是活物，依然是死灵，眼中闪着暗红的光芒，死死的盯着了郭飞。
郭飞眼睛一缩，一个狼似乎刚吃过活人，嘴边依然滴着血滴，还有新鲜的皮肉粘在嘴边。其背上一块干瘪的皮被撕裂，露出了白森森的骨骼，但此时，这块骨骼外面的皮竟然缓慢的愈合了，似乎有新鲜的血肉“补”了过去。
郭飞陡然明白，这些死灵为何会“着迷”活人的血肉，这些血肉可以补全、强健他们的身体，在人体死去的瞬间，体内大量的生机会变成死气，被其吸收，本能的进化，使得他们对活人的血肉极其的敏感。

（抱歉，今天停电了，这章更新晚了点！！）

Chapter 17 Undead Beast
After traveling for about twenty kilometers, the yellow sand gradually turned into dark brown soil. In the distance, black shadows lay like beasts on the dark wasteland, as if they wanted to devour anyone.
With Guo Fei's eyesight, even a few kilometers away, shrouded in darkness, he couldn't tell what was in front of him, he could just see an outline.
Guo Fei hesitated for a moment, then carefully directed the corpse soldiers to lead the way, and slowly approached this vast black shadow.
"Dead trees!" Looking closer, Guo Fei was surprised for a moment. These were rows of dead trees. The leaves had long fallen and rotted, but the huge trunks stood here in an intricate and messy manner. Some fell down, some were still standing, and some had rotted and turned into debris. Some precious and sturdy trees are still resisting the erosion of the years, standing tenaciously upright, as if expecting the sun to shine on this cold land again.
There is no doubt that this was once a vast dense forest, and the broken trees and branches tell the story of its former lushness.
"The sun used to be bright and the forest was dense. What happened? The sun no longer favored it and turned into a dead area?" Guo Fei walked quietly along the broken giant tree, filled with doubts in his heart.
"Ah!" A scream came from far in front, like a ghost calling.
Guo Fei moved forward more cautiously and looked around. In a dead forest, there seemed to be traces of a fight. Guo Fei lowered his head and took a handful of soil and smelled it. The smell of blood came to his face.
After careful inspection on the ground, yes, it was blood stains, and there were a lot of them.
While Guo Fei lowered his head to check, two dark red eyes appeared in a tree hole about three meters high in a dead tree as thick as a house nearby. The two eyes observed for a moment. Suddenly, these two eyes floated out of the air and rushed towards Guo Fei. When he got closer, he discovered that it was a big python as big as a bucket. It opened its big mouth and bit Guo Fei from above.
"Chi!" The body of the corpse soldier who was on guard suddenly spun up. The long sword in his hand danced and stabbed towards the python. The invisible sword energy drew out and made contact with the python's neck, making a violent shattering sound.
At this time, Guo Fei reacted quickly, turned over and jumped three meters away. I saw that the big python was struck by the corpse soldier's sword, and its neck was split open, revealing its waxy flesh.
"It's a dead spirit!" Guo Fei's heart was shocked. This big python was not a living creature, but a dead spirit.
The big python stared at Guo Fei fiercely, spitting out clouds of gray mist from his mouth, and the dark red light in his eyes became brighter and brighter. It was obvious that he had an extremely strong desire for Guo Fei's flesh.
Guo Fei did not dare to neglect. This python was huge in size and had amazing attack power. What was especially frightening was that his body was not afraid of harm. Based on Guo Fei's experience in fighting ghost soldiers, he must dig out the crystals in his eyes and eliminate the place where his soul resides before it will stop attacking.
The ninja scimitar withdrew, the shadow of the sword entered his body and turned into a sword weapon. Guo Fei took out the Black Iron Sword. If he were alone, he would probably have no choice but to escape today, but after obtaining a corpse soldier, Guo Fei was confident in dealing with this big python. The python seemed to have low intelligence and only stared at Guo Fei to attack. If the corpse soldiers did not take the initiative to attack it, it would turn a deaf ear.
"Death!" Guo Fei secretly shouted, his body suddenly floated up, his feet stepped on the dead wood, his body jumped ten feet high, and struck at the big snake.
The big python twisted its body, raised its huge head from the ground, and swallowed Guo Fei.
At the same time, Guo Fei's mind moved, and he commanded the corpse soldier to stand up suddenly. He inserted the sword into the python's half body and nailed it to the ground, instantly preventing it from jumping up.
At this moment that Guo Fei was waiting for, the black iron sword struck hard at the neck of the big python that lost the ability to move in an instant. The bucket-thick head fell with a sound, and the python's body suddenly fell to the ground, exuding a thick cloud of gray air. Guo Fei quickly got out of the way. This gray air flow made him extremely disgusted, and seemed to be able to dissolve the vitality in the body.
Corpse Soldiers RuleOtherwise, when he saw the thick gray air overflowing from the python's body, he cheered, moved to the gray air, opened his mouth, and suddenly inhaled the gray air into his mouth, sucking the rich air into his body like a whale sucking water.
After the gray air on the python's body dissipated, its shriveled skin and flesh instantly turned into fly ash, leaving only a skeleton. On its head, two fist-sized crystal blocks shimmered with blue light.
"Such a large piece of soul crystal!" Guo Fei was surprised and quickly took it in his hand and put it into the soldier talisman space.
"Hey!" Guo Fei glanced at the corpse soldier and found that his face was much rounder than before, and his dry skin actually bulged.
Could it be that after he absorbed the death energy, he could use it for himself?
Without thinking too much, Guo Fei transformed into a ninja, floated up, carefully jumped onto the tree trunk, and explored the tree hole. With the keenness of a ninja, Guo Fei did not find any foreign objects in the tree hole, but he still carefully let the corpse soldiers go in first, and then carefully probed in.
The space inside the cave is very large, about the size of a house, with many messy objects placed there, including a large number of bones and clothing. Guo Fei checked and found that the python had swallowed several human soldiers. Their flesh and blood may have been swallowed and digested by the python. The remaining clothes and bones were excreted. There were also two swords, three bows and three arrows on the ground.
Guo Fei ordered the corpse soldiers to sort it out and pick up valuable things. These are all wealth. Guo Fei was so poor that he naturally wanted to take away valuable things.
Among the clothes, I found twelve skull soul crystals the size of fingernails, two bags of fried noodles, and two unbroken water bags filled with water.
People are like rice and steel. Food is too important to Guo Fei. When he entered the Sunset Desert, he only brought a few days' worth of food. Without water or food, he couldn't last long.
Guo Fei put the weapons, soul crystals and food into the weapon space. He took out the food and water he had brought with him and started eating.
The corpse soldier had just absorbed the gray death energy and was much more energetic at this time. Guo Fei discovered that the corpse soldier did not have unlimited energy. He also had to consume energy in combat. Once the energy was insufficient, he would have no fighting power. His energy is these gray gases. With his current cultivation level, Guo Fei can already sense that this is a breath of death.
It was unusually hidden here, and the corpse soldiers didn't need to eat. Guo Fei asked the corpse soldiers to guard the entrance of the tree cave, and he leaned against the wall of the tree cave to rest.
It had been two days since the war started, and I had not rested. I was already tired, so I closed my eyes and fell asleep. In his sleep, Guo Fei seemed to be back in his university dormitory. His classmates had returned from vacation. They each took out the local specialties from their hometowns and shared them with each other, telling about their romantic encounters and dates during the vacation. They were fighting, shouting, drinking and eating until their mouths were full of oil.
"Shashasha!" A slight sound came from outside the tree hole. Guo Fei smacked his mouth, recalling the "little salted fish" in his hometown, and felt that "bird" faded out of his mouth. It seemed that he hadn't had a big meal in a long time. He woke up when he heard the noise, and he was secretly annoyed that something had interrupted his sweet dream.
The corpse soldiers lay vigilantly at the entrance of the tree hole, staring out with eager eyes. Guo Fei leaned over and took a look, and suddenly took a breath of air.
A pack of about fifty or sixty wolves surrounded the big tree. It's not a living thing, it's still a dead spirit, with dark red light shining in its eyes, staring at Guo Fei.
Guo Fei's eyes narrowed. It looked like a wolf that had just eaten a living person. There were still drops of blood around its mouth, and fresh flesh was still stuck to its mouth. A piece of shriveled skin on its back was torn, revealing white bones. But at this time, the skin outside the bone healed slowly, and it seemed that fresh flesh and blood had "replenished" it.
Guo Fei suddenly understood why these undead spirits were "obsessed" with the flesh and blood of living people. This flesh and blood could complement and strengthen their bodies. At the moment the human body dies, a large amount of life in the body will turn into death energy and be destroyed.Their absorption and instinctive evolution make them extremely sensitive to the flesh and blood of living people.
